policy: Reviewed replacement wrong replies for conversation questions whose correct reply was the only option repeating the question's key words. Each wrong reply shares the question's topic words but either states a wrong fact or answers a different question (when, where, who, how many, yes/no). Opinion questions use only the second kind, so no wrong reply could also be a true answer. The correct reply is unchanged and stays first.
